passage:
A bell at the harbor once warned fishermen of fog and storms. Modern weather systems made it unnecessary, but the bell remained on a wooden tower.
When a storm damaged the tower, the city considered removing it. Fishermen objected. They said the bell represented generations who had trusted sound when sight failed.
The tower was repaired, and a recording of old fishermen's stories was added nearby.
The bell no longer guided boats, but it guided memory.
Tools can lose practical use and gain symbolic duty. The harbor bell reminded the town that safety once depended on listening.
